name: @brodyazhnik/root
description: Brodyazhnik root workspace. Aggregates five packages: engine -> orchestrator -> prose-gate -> evals, and app (Next.js PWA over engine + orchestrator + prose-gate).

scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck -w engine && npm run typecheck -w orchestrator && npm run typecheck -w prose-gate && npm run typecheck -w evals && npm run typecheck -w app
scripts.test:all: node tools/check-lock-platforms.mjs && npm run test -w engine && npm run test -w orchestrator && npm run test -w prose-gate && npm run test -w evals && npm run test -w app
